column1: Purpose: See exactly where your revenue and expenses are coming from and going to, by category, every month and for the year.
1. Every number here pulls automatically from the Transactions tab based on each transaction's Category.
2. Revenue categories show as positive, expense categories show as negative, that's real cash movement for that category.
3. If you add a new category on the Transactions tab, add a matching row here so it shows up.
